research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Deako is researching user‑upgradeable load control and modular lighting systems. In User-upgradeable load control, a modular control unit with a backplate and contact elements controls power to load devices. Systems and methods for networked occupancy prediction describe modular control units defining detection zones and sharing occupancy data. Configurable modular devices and configurable devices focus on swappable wiring, LED light engine encodings, wireless network diagnostics, power transfer and replaceable modules, covering upgradeable control, occupancy sensing and modular lighting.

product.name: Smart Switch

product.description: A smart dimmer switch combining remote and tactile dimming control for adjustable lighting automation.

product.name: Simple Motion Sensor Switch
product.description: A switch that detects motion to automatically trigger lights, enabling hands-free lighting control.

product.name: Simple Nightlight Switch
product.description: A switch with a built-in nightlight providing subtle illumination for safety in dark rooms.

product.name: Simple Dimmer
product.description: A tactile slide dimmer switch that adjusts light brightness to create desired ambiance.

product.name: Simple Timer Switch
product.description: A switch with preset timers that automatically turn off lights after 10, 30, or 60 minutes.
